==Description==
[[Dorito]]'s apparence is an loaf orange cat with the eyes shining.

==Mechanic ==
Dorito spawns behind the current room’s door making drumming sounds. After 3-5 seconds, Dorito breaks the door and it will play an sound of someone saying "MMM Dorito" before checking every gray locker in the current and last 2 rooms. After checking Dorito will backtrack and despawning once it reaches the void wall. Any player found or getting close will get jumpscared by Dorito.

==Stats==
Kill Radius: 22 studs

Snipe Type: Doesn't Lockersnipe.

Tracking Type: Line of Sight.                          
==How to survive==
The same strategy from [[A-135]] one

==Trivia==
*'''Dorito''' was made to mimic [[A-120]]'s drumming sounds, meaning players mistake it for [[A-120]] and hide in a gray locker and die.
